note: Weights computed from |IC| at given horizon, normalized within bucket. Positive-IC signals (trend-following) get weight 0. V1.14 OVERRIDE: float_turnover_20d pinned at 0.5 = 50% of the positioning bucket (the other two signals share the remaining 0.5; within-bucket weights sum to 1.0) as a deliberate conceptual weight to recognize long/retail crowding, per user direction. Standalone 3m IC is weak (-0.006) so an IC-tuner would near-zero it, but composite IC is itself near-zero (-0.03) and face-validity (MU/SNDK correctly reading crowded) was the better guide. Costs ~0.01 of 3m composite IC (-0.034 -> -0.023).
